registered: 2026-11-25, before KinematiK's compliance solve was run on these cases
corner: benchmarks/direct_acting/corners/direct_upright.json (six two-force members, damper on the upright)

quantities.compliance_toe_deg: toe change from the unloaded pose, deg, + toe-out
quantities.compliance_camber_deg: camber change from the unloaded pose, deg, front-view projection
quantities.contact_patch_lateral_mm: lateral movement of the contact-patch point carried by the upright, mm

limits.rule: a result passes if it is within the absolute OR the relative limit of each reference
